mcqs.question: In the Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) programme, what was the reported strength of community resource persons and the share of women among them?
options: 10,000+ community resource persons, with over 60% being women
5,922 community resource persons, with over 60% being women
10,000+ community resource persons, with 3.4 lakh being women
25,000 community resource persons, with over 60% being women
mcqs.explanation: APCNF had more than 10,000 community resource persons, and over 60% of them were women. The tempting figure of 5,922 refers to Master Trainers under the Yogandhra-2026 campaign, not APCNF community resource persons.

mcqs.question: How many Master Trainers were associated with the Yogandhra-2026 campaign in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: The Yogandhra-2026 campaign had 5,922 Master Trainers. The figures 25,000 and 50,752 refer to other campaign figures, while 2.5 lakh was the training target.
